managed_start.label: Managed Start (Console)
managed_start.description: saba-runner holds the server console, so you can see it and type commands in saba-chan. If you turn this off, the server runs as a separate process in its own window, and the saba-chan console and command input (stdin) do not work.

ip.label: Listen IP
ip.description: IP address the server listens on (-ip). Empty = all addresses

lobby.label: Steam Lobby
lobby.description: Who can join through Steam (-lobby, needs Steam Support)

announcement_box_range.label: Announcement Box Range
announcement_box_range.description: Message range in pixels, -1 = whole server

world_name.label: World Name
world_name.description: World file name (<name>.wld) and the name of a new world

world_dir.label: World Folder
world_dir.description: Folder where world files are kept (worldpath)

autocreate.label: New World Size
autocreate.description: Size of the world created when none exists: 1 small, 2 medium, 3 large

seed.label: New World Seed
seed.description: Seed for a newly created world

port.label: Port
port.description: TCP port the server listens on

upnp.label: UPnP Port Forwarding
upnp.description: Forward the port automatically with UPnP

banlist.label: Ban List File
banlist.description: Ban list file name in the server folder

npcstream.label: NPC Stream
npcstream.description: Enemy sync: lower skips less but uses more bandwidth. 0 = off

priority.label: Process Priority
priority.description: 0 Realtime, 1 High, 2 AboveNormal, 3 Normal, 4 BelowNormal, 5 Idle

seed_celebration.label: Celebration Seed
seed_celebration.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

seed_theconstant.label: The Constant
seed_theconstant.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

seed_notthebees.label: Not the Bees!
seed_notthebees.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

seed_notraps.label: No Traps
seed_notraps.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

seed_fortheworthy.label: For the Worthy
seed_fortheworthy.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

seed_remix.label: Remix
seed_remix.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

seed_drunk.label: Drunk
seed_drunk.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

seed_zenith.label: Zenith
seed_zenith.description: Enable the special world seed: 0 disabled, 1 enabled

worldrollbackstokeep.label: World Rollbacks to Keep
worldrollbackstokeep.description: Number of world rollback backups to keep

say.label: Announce
say.description: Send a message to all players

motd.label: Message of the Day
motd.description: Show the message of the day

password.label: Show Password
password.description: Print the server password on the server console

settle.label: Settle Liquids
settle.description: Settle all water in the world

kick.label: Kick Player
kick.description: Kick a player from the server

ban.label: Ban Player
ban.description: Ban a player (written to the ban list)

exit-nosave.label: Stop Without Saving
exit-nosave.description: Stop the server without saving the world

errors.executable_not_found: Terraria server executable not found. Install the server first.
errors.invalid_banlist: Ban list name "{{name}}" is not a plain file name
errors.invalid_world_name: World name "{{name}}" cannot contain / \ : * ? " < > | or end with a space or dot.
errors.not_server_folder: No Terraria server in this folder; nothing deleted
errors.server_not_in_archive: No {{file}} for this system in the downloaded file
errors.server_reset_partial: Some world files could not be deleted: {{errors}}
errors.settings_write_failed: Server installed, but writing settings failed: {{error}}
errors.version_list_failed: Server version list download from terraria.org failed: {{error}}
errors.xna_framework_missing: XNA Framework 4.0 files missing from the server folder. Reinstalling the server adds them.
errors.xna_install_failed: Adding XNA Framework 4.0 to the server folder failed: {{error}}

messages.properties_updated: Saved to serverconfig.txt. Restart the server to apply.
messages.server_reset_complete: World deleted. A new world is created on the next start.
messages.installing_xna: Adding XNA Framework 4.0 to the server folder...

reset.label: Reset World
reset.description: Deletes this server's world file and its .wld.bak and .wld.bak<number> backups. serverconfig.txt, the ban list, other worlds and server files stay. A new world is created on the next start.

items.world: World file and the backups the game made (.bak)
